mapper.insert: insert into tb_routine_template (user_id, template_name, ex_category_cd, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{templateName}, #{exCategoryCd}, NOW())
insert into tb_routine_template_item (template_id, exercise_item_name, sort_order, created_at) values (#{templateId}, #{exerciseItemName}, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
insert into tb_routine_template_set (template_item_id, set_no, planned_weight_kg, planned_reps, created_at) values (#{templateItemId}, #{setNo}, #{plannedWeightKg}, #{plannedReps}, NOW())
mapper.select: select trt.user_id, trt.template_id, trt.template_name, trt.ex_category_cd, trti.template_item_id, trti.sort_order, trti.exercise_item_name, trts.set_no, trts.planned_weight_kg, trts.planned_reps from tb_routine_template trt join tb_routine_template_item trti on trt.template_id = trti.template_id join tb_routine_template_set trts on trti.template_item_id = trts.template_item_id where trt.user_id = #{loginId}

select trt.user_id, trt.template_id, trt.template_name, trt.ex_category_cd, trti.template_item_id , trti.sort_order, trti.exercise_item_name, trts.set_no, trts.template_set_id, trts.planned_weight_kg, trts.planned_reps from tb_routine_template trt join tb_routine_template_item trti on trt.template_id = trti.template_id join tb_routine_template_set trts on trti.template_item_id = trts.template_item_id where trt.template_id = #{templateId} order by trti.sort_order, trts.set_no
